name: @radiotools/sdk-generator
description: Generate RadioTools SDKs for multiple frameworks from @radiotools/contract

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const f of ['cli.js','index.js']) { const p='dist/'+f; writeFileSync(p, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+readFileSync(p)); }"
